title: Listen and Choose a Response — Shared Apartment

questions.stem: Did you pay the electricity bill this month?

options.A: Oh no, I completely forgot. I'll do it tonight.
options.B: The electricity went out during the storm.
options.C: Yes, I'll pay it next month.
options.D: Bill is coming over this evening.

questions.explanation: Admitting forgetting and promising to pay answers the question; the 'Bill' option plays on the word's other meaning.
questions.speaker: m6

audioSegments.text: Did you pay the electricity bill this month?
